answers.core: It feels like GDScript imparts a significant performance overhead for performing this low-level of memory manipulation. It could also be used in various scenarios and could have direct impact of the available functionality of any situation in which binary data serialization is relevant (eg: network packets, save files, resource/configuration files).
answers.workaround: Utility functions to achieve the desired effect could be implemented in GDScript as an add-on, but it would require a considerable amount of code to be flexible.
